A LineCurve effect that fills the area under the curve with a color gradient.

detaileddescription.para: Attach to LineCurve::effects to render a shaded fill between the curve and a configurable baseline. Both the fill direction and color stops are taken from a Qt Gradient object assigned to gradient.
